sloka: स सायको रावणबाहुमुक्तः शक्राशनिप्रख्यवपुः शिताग्रः ।सुग्रीवमासाद्य बिभेद वेगाद् गुहेरिता क्रौञ्चमिवोग्रशक्तिः ।। ६.५९.४० ।।।।
transliteration: sa sāyako rāvaṇabāhumuktaḥ śakrāśaniprakhyavapuḥ śitāgraḥ ।sugrīvamāsādya bibheda vegād guheritā krauñcamivograśaktiḥ ।। 6.59.40 ।।।।

translations.english: That arrow released from Ravana's arm, which was hard and sharp as the thunderbolt of Indra, pierced Sugriva just as the sharp thorn edged spear of Guha penetrated Krauncha mountain.
